entities.summary: Paramount Network is an American cable television channel and the flagship property of the Paramount Media Networks division of Paramount Skydance Corporation, who operates it through the MTV Entertainment Group. The network's headquarters are located at the Paramount Pictures studio lot in Los Angeles. The channel was originally founded by a partnership between radio station WSM and Westinghouse Broadcasting as The Nashville Network (TNN) and began broadcasting on March 7, 1983.
